housing: Riverside's rentals are mostly single-family homes and stucco garden apartment complexes, with older bungalows near downtown and student housing around UC Riverside.

tenantHelp.name: Fair Housing Council of Riverside County

climate: Test the air conditioning and photograph the outdoor unit; Riverside summers are very hot, so a broken AC is an urgent repair.
fact: Under California law, landlords must photograph a unit at move-in and move-out for tenancies that began on or after July 1, 2025, so dated photos matter in Riverside deposit disputes.
